# GSM Driving School

> George's School of Motoring (GSM) — manual and automatic driving lessons in West London since 2005 (20+ years). Based in Notting Hill, W11. Rated 5.0 from 147 Google reviews.

Phone / WhatsApp: 07961 585231 (+44 7961 585231)
Email: gsmdrivingschool@outlook.com
Address: 71 Sandbourne House, Dartmouth Close, London W11 1DS
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@GSMDrivingSchool
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/gsm_driving_school_
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/share/1HySrwY5AA/

Automatic lessons with George; manual lessons with the GSM team. Beginners, nervous drivers, refresher lessons and test preparation. Students from neighbouring areas (e.g. South Kensington) can be picked up from an agreed meeting point. 48 hours' notice is needed to cancel or reschedule.
